3.name: Fast Hands & Second-Story Work
3.description: Use Cunning Action for Sleight of Hand, Thieves' Tools, or Use an Object; climb costs no extra movement and jump distance adds DEX modifier feet.

9.name: Supreme Sneak
9.description: Advantage on Stealth checks if you move no more than half your speed on the same turn.

13.name: Use Magic Device
13.description: Ignore all class, race, and level requirements on the use of magic items.

17.name: Thief's Reflexes
17.description: Take two turns during the first round of any combat (Initiative and Initiative - 10).

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies & Assassinate
3.description: Gain disguise kit & poisoner's kit; Advantage on attacks against targets who haven't acted yet, and hits on surprised creatures are automatic Critical Hits.

9.name: Infiltration Expertise
9.description: Unfailingly create false identities (7 days and 25 gp).

13.name: Impostor
13.description: Unerringly mimic another person's speech, writing, and behavior after 3 hours of study.

17.name: Death Strike
17.description: Surprised creatures hit by your attack must make a CON save or take double damage from the attack.

assassinate.name: Assassinate
assassinate.hint: Advantage against creatures that haven't taken a turn. Hits against surprised creatures are critical hits.

3.name: Spellcasting & Mage Hand Legerdemain
3.description: Cast Wizard spells (INT; Illusion/Enchantment focus) and make Mage Hand invisible to pick locks/pockets at 30 ft via Cunning Action.

9.name: Magical Ambush
9.description: Targets have Disadvantage on saving throws against your spells if you are hidden from them when casting.

13.name: Versatile Trickster
13.description: Bonus Action uses Mage Hand to distract a target within 5 ft, granting Advantage on your attacks against it.

17.name: Spell Thief
17.description: Reaction attempts to negate and temporarily steal a spell cast at you (1/Long Rest).

3.name: Master of Intrigue & Master of Tactics
3.description: Gain disguise/forgery kits, 2 languages, and mimicry; use Help as a Bonus Action with a 30-ft range.

9.name: Insightful Manipulator
9.description: Observe a creature outside combat for 1 min to learn two relative stats/HP/levels.

13.name: Misdirection
13.description: Reaction redirects an attack targeting you onto an adjacent creature providing you cover.

17.name: Soul of Deceit
17.description: Your thoughts cannot be read, and you can present false thoughts on Deception checks; magic always thinks you tell the truth.

3.name: Fancy Footwork & Rakish Audacity
3.description: Targets you melee-attack cannot make Opportunity Attacks against you this turn; add CHA mod to Initiative and Sneak Attack 1v1 duels cleanly.

9.name: Panache
9.description: Action Insight/Persuasion check charms friendly targets or goads hostile targets into focusing on you.

13.name: Elegant Maneuver
13.description: Bonus Action grants Advantage on your next Acrobatics or Athletics check.

17.name: Master Duelist
17.description: Reroll a missed attack roll with Advantage once per Short or Long Rest.

3.name: Ear for Deceit, Eye for Detail & Insightful Fighting
3.description: Treat rolls <= 7 as 8 on Insight to spot lies; Cunning Action Perception/Investigation; Bonus Action Insight contest enables Sneak Attack for 1 minute.

9.name: Steady Eye
9.description: Advantage on Perception and Investigation checks if you move no more than half your speed.

13.name: Unerring Eye
13.description: Sense illusions, shapechangers, and magic within 30 ft (WIS mod/Long Rest).

17.name: Eye for Weakness
17.description: Add +3d6 extra Sneak Attack damage against targets under your Insightful Fighting.

3.name: Skirmisher & Survivalist
3.description: Gain proficiency & Expertise in Nature and Survival; Reaction moves half speed without Opportunity Attacks when an enemy ends its turn within 5 ft.

9.name: Superior Mobility
9.description: Your walking, climbing, and swimming speeds increase by +10 feet.

13.name: Ambush Master
13.description: Advantage on Initiative rolls; the first creature you hit on turn 1 takes attacks from all allies at Advantage until your next turn.

17.name: Sudden Strike
17.description: Bonus Action weapon attack after Attack action can also deal Sneak Attack damage to a second target.

3.name: Whispers of the Dead & Wails from the Grave
3.description: Swap a bonus skill/tool after rests; deal half Sneak Attack dice Necrotic damage to a second creature within 30 ft (PB/Long Rest).

9.name: Tokens of the Departed
9.description: Reaction captures Soul Trinkets from dying creatures granting Adv on Death/CON saves or fueling extra Wails uses.

13.name: Ghost Walk
13.description: Bonus Action turns spectral (10 ft Fly, hover, pass through walls, enemy attacks at Disadvantage; 1/Long Rest or 1 Soul Trinket).

17.name: Death's Friend
17.description: Wails from the Grave also deals its Necrotic damage to your first target, and you regain a Soul Trinket whenever rolling Initiative with 0 left.

wails_from_the_grave.name: Wails from the Grave
wails_from_the_grave.hint: Deal necrotic damage to a second creature within 30 ft of the first target.

3.name: Psionic Power & Psychic Blades
3.description: Pool of 2x PB Psionic Energy Dice (d6->d12) for Psi-Bolstered Knack & Psychic Whispers; manifest 1d6/1d4 Psychic Blades leaving no wounds.

9.name: Soul Blades
9.description: Spend a Psionic Die when missing with a Psychic Blade (Homing Strikes) or throw one to teleport up to 10x roll ft (Psychic Teleportation).

13.name: Psychic Veil
13.description: Action turns Invisible for 1 hour (1/Long Rest or 1 Psionic Die).

17.name: Rend Mind
17.description: Deal Sneak Attack with Psychic Blade to force a WIS save or Stun the target for 1 minute (1/Long Rest or 3 Psionic Dice).
